about: Where points fall in the reference photos (references.json, dvids*), in pixels of the full-size image, read off by eye at full resolution, and which points' coordinates the sources cite. verify/photos.py solves every photo's camera and every marked point together from these: points are [station, waterline, buttline] in inches, null where no source gives the coordinate, with the uncertainty in inches. Points a photo marks that are not listed here are measured, never cited. Pairs ending _left and _right are solved as one point and its mirror image. Each photo's pose drives the model as the jet stood (gear down, surfaces as the photo shows them) for its outline and curves. A pose's "joints" sets single surfaces in radians past their drives: each is verify/poses.py's fit of that surface to the photo's own outline against the sky (2026-11-01, on the build with the flap ending at BL 153), kept where it halves a miss of 0.7 in or more, lies within tp209033's travel limits (facts surfaces.limits) and agrees with its pair: the rudders toed in on the take-off series, the stabilators about 10 deg trailing edge up on the ground, the flaps and ailerons a few degrees off in flight. navy090707N7665E003 takes none: its camera, through a window, cannot be trusted aft of the nose. The trailing-edge flaps' outer corners (fold_trailing) are set aside in every photo (2026-11-06): the flaps droop a few degrees in flight where the photos' poses hold them neutral, and their marks pulled the cameras (out of the solve, dvids6690145's fit fell from 6.7 to 2.6 px and dvids7487365's from 2.5 to 2.0; fitting the flaps instead moved other photos' cameras off the fins). Marks on parts whose pose a photo cannot fix are set aside when a sweep is merged (2026-11-06): in flight the stabilators' tips, the wingtips' trailing corners and lex_wing (on the drooped leading-edge flap), and the axles with the gear down (the struts hang extended); on the ground the stabilators' tips (their trim read by eye) and the wingtips' corners on folded panels (the fold's angle is measured, not solved on); a lowered hook's point and anything on the lowered hook, which stretched the frame once (f54337945831's hook_pivot, on a boss of the lowered shank). Every point is measured, cited and reported with the gear down and every surface neutral ("pose"): the cited axles are the gear-down wheel centres, and a mark on a part a photo poses otherwise is carried into that photo's pose. A photo's pose shows the store parts its own stores entry names ("joints": {part: 1}), each a show joint the build hides at rest.

apex.why: facts nose.apex (tp3360; tp209033, tm110216 and tp3111 within 0.7 in) on datum.apex (cr3608: WL 100)

wingtip_trailing_right.why: facts wing (cr201687 planform from tp209033's mean chord leading edge, FS 423.99) and reference.span (hatp: 37.417 ft; natops 37.5 ft)

fin_tip_leading_right.why: facts fin.top (cr3608); hatp draws it 4 in higher and natops's height puts it 2.5 in higher, so loosely

axle_main_right.why: facts layout.gear (tp209033 figure 2's wheel centres: wheelbase 17.77 ft)

dvids9820808.notes: The far main wheel shows its inboard face, so it is not marked as axle_main_left (the outboard hub face). The canopy's aft lower corner is not separable from its aft end at this angle. hook_point is the aft end of the stowed hook's visible shank. radome_top and probe_door_front are left to dvids9820810 and dvids9820801, which mark them on the same construction. Inlets (added later): The existing inlet_lip_top_right [3591, 2727] and inlet_lip_bottom_right [3591, 3055] are NOT on the lip. They sit at the splitter plate's leading edge, about 420 px forward of the lip: the bottom one is the plate's lower front corner (splitter_bottom_right here) and the top one is in the dark boundary-layer gap about 30 px forward of the plate's top end under the LEX. The existing inlet_lip_right edge also traces the splitter's leading edge, not the lip, and should be dropped (splitter_right here replaces it). The lip is the D-shaped edge at x 3125-3205 with the JET INTAKE DANGER chevron behind it; the large lit plate with streaks from x 3130 to 3590 is the splitter plate continuing into the duct's inboard wall. The view is about 27 deg ahead of the beam (fin-tip parallax), so the wall shows through the mouth. inlet_lip_top_right corrected to [3174, 2792]: the top of the lit lip band against the dark recess under the LEX, flat over x 3165-3185 (x +-8, y +-3). inlet_lip_bottom_right has no corrected value: the lip's lowest point is hidden, the lit bottom lip running down into the external tank's upper outline at x 3130-3185, y 3097-3105; delete the existing mark. inlet_lip_outer_right not marked: the lip's front edge reaches its outboard extreme at x 3125, flat over y 2905-2955 (centre about 2940), but the outer-side point the dictionary asks for has no visible feature here (the cowl behind the lip is evenly lit). inlet_corner_top_right is where the top lip band ends at the inboard wall, beside a dark corner shadow (+-6). inlet_corner_bottom_right is where the lip's lower outline turns into the splitter plate's straight bottom edge (+-6 along the curve), the same construction as dvids9820788. splitter_top_right is where the leading edge meets the LEX underside (the edge stays visible in the shadow up to y 2705); splitter_bottom_right is the plate's rounded lower front corner. The lip's front edge, for reference (not recorded as an edge because its bottom is hidden): [3151, 2810], [3140, 2830], [3134, 2850], [3130, 2870], [3127, 2890], [3125, 2910], [3125, 2950], [3127, 2990], [3129, 3030]. HOOK (2026-10-31): hook_pivot is the centre of the round end cap on the stowed hook's pivot fitting; hook_point the shoe's aft tip. The cap with its dark bore at (1043, 3118) (+-4 px); hook_point is not marked: the old mark (735, 3055) and the kink at (718, 3049) are where the shank passes into the body's outline (FS ~680), not the shoe, which the navy photo puts by the nozzles; here the shoe is lost in the shadow under the nozzles (a faint step in the outline at (507, 3013), FS ~709, is too faint to mark). STORES (seen in the stores pass, 2026-11-08): 1: not seen (left wingtip hidden behind the fuselage); 2: not seen; 3: 330-gal tank (only its black-painted nose seen, under and past the right tank); its SUU-63 not seen; 4: not seen; 5: LITENING targeting pod (dome sensor head, laser DANGER label) on its own centreline adapter, nose about FS 356; no SUU-62, no tank; 6: no missile; any LAU-116 not distinguishable in the inlet's lower corner; 7: SUU-63 and 330-gal tank; 8: bare SUU-63; 9: LAU-7 rail, empty (no missile).

dvids9820756.notes: SIDES: the nozzles face the camera and the canopy/nose recede to photo-left, so the camera is behind the jet's LEFT quarter, not its right: the left fuselage side, the outer face of the left fin (AM, 04) and MARINES lettering reading nose-to-tail are what face the camera. Photo-left fin/stab/wing/nozzle = aircraft left. Camera is below the wing/stab plane (stabs sit above the horizon), so wing and stab undersides are seen. DEFLECTIONS: trailing-edge flaps and ailerons are drooped, roughly 25-35 deg by eye (their lower surfaces show as broad white panels below each wing, the aileron's outboard edge a diagonal at each tip); stabilators look trailing-edge-up (leading edge down) roughly 5-12 deg on both sides (each tip chord rises from the LE corner to the TE corner); LE flaps not judged. SKIPPED: wingtip corners (the trailing corner is on the drooped aileron; the leading corner is hidden by the tip rail and AIM-9); stab trailing tip corners are heavily rounded and the right stab's leading tip corner has no visible kink; right main wheel hub hidden behind a firefighter; hook point not identifiable; nozzle root not distinct. LEAST CERTAIN: stabilator_tip_leading_left (+-5 px along the edge, it touches the dark wing trailing-edge band behind it); axle marks (+-5 px, centre of the hub/rim ellipse); nozzle_exit_bottom_* are the half-intensity edge between the lit inner surface and the dark lip at the bottom of each exit (+-4 px). TIE POINTS (no model counterpart): spine_blade_top = top of the small blade antenna on the spine behind the canopy; lettering_dash_left = centre of the dash in VMFA-112 on the left fuselage side. Both also marked in dvids9820753 and dvids9820758. fin_leading_right has no snap: the background changes from sky to trees along it, so the contrast flips sign (point at 5298,2342 left out there). OUT OF THE SOLVE (2026-11-01): a long lens from far behind (field 1-3 deg) with its marks bunched at the tail. Once the bundle carried each photo's own stabilator pose into its stabilator marks, this photo and its two neighbours of the same series (dvids9820753, 9820756, 9820758) stopped being outliers the bundle ignored (25 px rms) and began to steer it, their depth and focal length trading freely (dvids9820758's camera slid out to the 1 deg floor): with them, 27 edges on fixed structure failed by 1.6-2.4 in; without them, 1. dvids8257577, a view from directly behind at a 10 deg field, covers the tail instead.

The left nozzle's lip never stands against background here (fuselage and other nozzle behind it). SKIPPED: hook point (cannot pick the stowed hook out under the nozzles); right stab tip (only its rounded trailing corner shows); nozzle roots. LEAST CERTAIN: axle_main_left (+-6 px, centre of the rim/hub ellipse); stabilator_tip_leading_left (+-4 px, touches the wing trailing-edge band behind it); nozzle exit bottoms (+-4 px, same definition as dvids9820756). spine_blade_top and lettering_dash_left are tie points shared with dvids9820756 and dvids9820753. dvids9820744.notes: Planform from below, nose to photo-right, so the aircraft's RIGHT wing/stab/nozzle are at the photo TOP (checked by handedness: belly toward camera, nose right => right wing up). Stores: AIM-9 on both tip rails, pylon stores and two wing tanks, centreline store; edges avoid them (wing leading edges are split around the inboard tank/pylon and stop short of the leading-edge snag). wingtip_trailing_* is where the trailing edge meets the tip rail's inner edge (the rail sits along the tip; within a few px of the wing's own corner). fold_trailing_left = centre of a sky slot through the left wing at the trailing edge between flap and aileron (the slot is visible because they sit at different angles); no such slot shows on the right wing. nozzle_*_exit trace the aft end of each nozzle against sky; nozzle point marks are not meaningful from below. DEFLECTIONS: stabilators cannot be judged from below; TE flaps/ailerons at unknown, probably small, angles (left aileron and flap differ, per the slot), which could shift the trailing-edge outlines slightly in planform. SKIPPED: lex_apex_right (the kink is soft: the two edge fits meet 4305-4331, too uncertain); stabilator trailing tip corners (heavily rounded, tangent intersection ~20 px off the outline); wingtip leading corners (rails/missiles). LEAST CERTAIN: lex_wing_right/left (+-5 px, the junctions are slightly filleted; the tangent-line intersection on the right sits ~7 px aft-outboard at 3812,3074); stabilator_tip_leading_right (corner rounded, +-4 px).

dvids9820753.notes: Same scene as dvids9820756, slightly closer: camera behind the jet's LEFT quarter (left fuselage side and left fin's outer face toward camera), below the stab plane; photo-left = aircraft left. Fin tips: the antenna/ECM pods hang below the trailing corners; the marks are the fins' own top corners. fin_tip_leading_right is a slightly rounded corner (+-3 px). DEFLECTIONS: TE flaps and ailerons drooped roughly 25-35 deg (white lower-surface panels under both wings); stabilators trailing-edge-up roughly 5-12 deg, as in dvids9820756. Nose gear: axle_nose_left is the near (left) nose wheel's light-coloured hub; the right nose wheel is mostly hidden behind the strut. axle_main_left is the larger spoked wheel with the main leg rising aft of it. SKIPPED: wingtip corners (drooped aileron / tip rail and missile), stab trailing tip corners (rounded) and the right stab's leading tip corner (no kink), right main wheel (hidden), hook, nozzle roots; the right nozzle's lip stands against sky for only ~60 px with weak contrast, so no nozzle edge here. LEAST CERTAIN: axle marks (+-5 px); nozzle exit bottoms (+-4 px, same definition as dvids9820756); spine_blade_top (+-3 px, soft top). OUT OF THE SOLVE (2026-11-01): a long lens from far behind (field 1-3 deg) with its marks bunched at the tail. Once the bundle carried each photo's own stabilator pose into its stabilator marks, this photo and its two neighbours of the same series (dvids9820753, 9820756, 9820758) stopped being outliers the bundle ignored (25 px rms) and began to steer it, their depth and focal length trading freely (dvids9820758's camera slid out to the 1 deg floor): with them, 27 edges on fixed structure failed by 1.6-2.4 in; without them, 1. dvids8257577, a view from directly behind at a 10 deg field, covers the tail instead.

dvids7418477.notes: Wide-angle, close camera roughly abeam the nose gear: far-side features shift strongly forward (right fin tip ~950 px forward of the left one, right main wheel ~1000 px). Nose tip and left fin trailing corner are outside the frame. bow_top is the top of the fixed windscreen's aft arch (canopy raised); it sits on a flat top, so +-10 px along x. lex_fence_* are the top corners of the left LEX fence (also marked in dvids9820782 and dvids8678629). Not marked: the LEX leading edge (two parallel boundaries, a thin dark line and a lit band's lower edge, and I could not tell for certain which is the edge; the fence's base being cut off along the upper line suggests the camera is below the LEX and the upper line is the edge); right main axle (wheel seen from its inboard side, brake hardware in front of the hub); nose wheels (near hub hidden by the standing person); inlet lip; gun port and radome joint (the gun fairing is a long slot with no clear centre). Control-surface deflections not assessed. windscreen_top (2026-11-01) was marked as bow_top: with the canopy raised the mark is the fixed windscreen's aft arch, not the bow, which rose with the canopy; carried with the canopy's pose it missed by 70 in. CANOPY (2026-11-02): left at the model's full 45 deg: verify/poses.py fits 54.4 deg but only takes the miss from 2.73 in to 1.90, not the half a fit needs.

dvids9820782.notes: Camera is above the LEX plane: the LEX top surface shows as a lit band and lex_edge_left is its lower (outer) boundary against the shadow beneath. Takeoff configuration: leading-edge flaps, trailing-edge flaps and ailerons drooped well down (the drooped flap and aileron undersides hang visibly below the wing), so no wingtip or fold marks and no lex_wing_left (the drooped LEF's root splits the kink). canopy_sill_left is the dark canopy-to-fuselage seam from just aft of the bow to sill_aft_left; it carries no snap because it is a thin line, and the points are on its centre. lex_fence_* are the top corners of the left LEX fence (also marked in the other two shelter/profile photos). Not marked: bow_foot_left (frame foot vs canopy corner differ by ~30 px), canopy_crown/canopy_aft (flat top, seam meets the outline unclearly), gun port, radome joint, inlet lip, right nose axle (hub behind the strut). windscreen_base is not marked: from above, the frame's side corner is not the centreline point. STORES (seen in the stores pass, 2026-11-08): 1: LAU-7 with an AIM-9M-type round: hemispherical seeker dome, four large double-delta canards, four large tail wings; a blue band just aft of the canards and a red-orange band further aft on the body - blue is the inert/training colour, so most likely a CATM-9M captive training round (not certain); 2: bare SUU-63; 3: SUU-63 and 330-gal tank (black-painted nose cone, chipped); 4: no missile; 5: LITENING pod on its centreline adapter (between the tanks, under the inlets); 6: not seen; 7: 330-gal tank (nose seen under the forward fuselage, beside the nose-gear tow fitting); 8: not seen; 9: not seen.

dvids9820749.notes: This is a left-REAR quarter near profile, not front: both nozzle exits face the camera, the near (left) fin sits forward of the far one in the image and the far main wheel appears aft of the near one. Long lens, some heat shimmer. Fin tip trailing marks are the fins' own corners above the antenna fairings. windscreen_base is where the white-reflecting windscreen meets the dark nose silhouette (+-5 px). Stabilators look strongly deflected and the right rudder shows a pale sliver (rudders probably toed in), so no stabilator marks. Not marked: nozzle exit/root bottoms (flat-bottomed ellipses, x uncertain), right main axle (hub in deep shadow), wingtip (missile in front), nose top outline (radome nearly the same brightness as the sky). HOOK (2026-10-31): the hook is down and on the arresting cable; the shoe's tip at [5525, 2935] is cast onto the centreline (cast.py), not marked: the two photos catch the hook at different moments, so it is no single point, and a mark would pull the camera, the shank's round aft end on the cable, motion-blurred (+-8 px). The pivot is hidden. STORES (seen in the stores pass, 2026-11-08): 1: LAU-7 with an AIM-9M-type round (seeker dome, canards near the nose, cruciform tail wings); 2: bare SUU-63; 3: SUU-63 and 330-gal tank (black nose cone); 4: no missile; 5: not distinguishable (under the fuselage in shadow); 6: not seen; 7: not seen; 8: not seen; 9: not seen (behind the nozzles).

dvids8678629.notes: Close wide-angle camera. lex_edge_left is the single sharp lit-to-shadow boundary under the LEX, which is the outer edge whichever side of the LEX plane the camera is on. apex is the leftmost point of the small radome tip cap. axle_nose_left is the centre of the near (left) nose wheel's rim and hub cavity; the protruding axle cap sits ~15 px to the right of it. spine is the upper-fuselage silhouette aft of the open canopy against the bright shelter opening; it stops before the LEX fence. The leading-edge flap looks drooped (its inboard end stands proud at the LEX-wing junction), so no lex_wing_left. Not marked: windscreen_base and bow_top (view too oblique to place the centreline points), left fin trailing corner (rounded, antenna fairing on it), inlet lip (the visible dark seam may be a joint behind the actual lip edge), main axle (wheel seen nearly edge-on), wingtip (out of frame). CANOPY (2026-11-02): open 30.4 deg, fitted by verify/poses.py against the sky (2.54 in over 135 places at the model's full 45 deg, 0.56 over 113); dvids8678631, the same jet in the same shelter, fits 30.8. MASK: the edge of a pale cloud band behind the spine at FS 505-515 (y 2695-2722), which the walk read as the jet's edge 4.4-5.3 in out (2026-11-05).

dvids9820791.notes: Not orthographic: the jet is seen from slightly to its LEFT (about 10-12 deg of yaw): the nose apex sits ~150 px photo-right of the wingtips' midpoint and the fins are shifted photo-left. Arresting cable stretched across the runway in front of the jet. Wingtips NOT marked: each tip carries a rail with a pod/missile (rounded nose and fins, see the ACMI-type pod on the right tip in dvids9820799); the wing's own tip corners cannot be separated from the rail here. Wing edges stop ~20 px inboard of the rails. Inlet lips NOT marked: both inlets are in deep shadow; the right lip is a faint grey ring with no contrasting outer boundary (top ~y1580 at x~3255, unreliable), the left inlet is mostly hidden behind the radome. Fin tips NOT marked: each fin tip is seen nearly end-on (~12 px wide), leading and trailing corners cannot be told apart (topmost points: right fin ~(3099,1317), left fin ~(3425,1318)). Apex NOT marked: the radome tip faces the camera and shows no point (light highlight disc centred ~(3466,1617), +-6 px). bow_top is the apex of the white windscreen arch (parabola fit of its top edge, x +-2); the transparent canopy behind it rises higher but its outline is invisible, so no canopy outline edge is given. Wheels are seen tread-on; axle points are the centres of each tyre's silhouette bounding box (top to ground contact), +-3 px; the left main tyre's top at y~1693 vs right main ~1697. The inner wing panels look thicker than the outer panels: a step in both the upper and lower right-wing outline at the fold line (x~2930), consistent with leading/trailing-edge flaps drooped on the inner panel (or the fold joint fairing); the edges are split there. Wing upper edges are white leading-edge/upper surface against dark trees; lower edges are the shadowed underside against trees. The wheel marks are the centres of each tyre's silhouette (wheel_*), not hub faces (axle_*). Left out of the solve: five marks cannot fix its camera (the wingtips, inlets, fin tips and apex cannot be placed in it).

dvids9820799.notes: Near (right) fin is the one at photo-left (x 3800-4400); the far (left) fin rises behind the canopy (x 5400-5650). Forward is photo-right. Right wingtip carries a pod on its rail (rounded nose with a small probe below, extending ahead of the LE and behind the TE). wingtip_trailing_right / wingtip_leading_right are where the wing's trailing / leading edge meets that pod, i.e. the wing's own corners as seen against the rail (+-3 px; leading corner is the end of the shadowed LE line). In this view the wing's leading edge is the LOWER edge of the white wing band (pylons hang from it) and the trailing edge is the upper one; wing_right_trailing is that upper edge against trees. sill_aft_right: where the dark canopy-sill gap line ends; the canopy's aft edge rising from it is faint (+-3 px, least sure of this one). The right nose axle is the visible hub centre of the obliquely seen wheel (+-4 px). The left one, marked at first on the far wheel's inboard face, is dropped (2026-11-01): marking.md marks a hub only where its outboard face shows. Right main axle not marked: wheel nearly edge-on, hub ambiguous by ~10 px. Apex NOT marked: the radome tip is seen obliquely as a rounded glossy blob (~(7082,2529)); its forward-most point is ambiguous by ~10 px. Gun port / radome joint / windscreen base NOT marked (not resolvable to a few px at this angle). light_strip_aft_corner = top-aft corner of the aft-most of the three formation-light strips under the '04'; light_strip_forward_corner = bottom-forward corner of the forward-most strip (same points marked in dvids9820810 and dvids9820801). Canopy edge is the canopy glass outline aft of the crown only. Stabilators hidden behind pylons/stores. Arresting cable lies on the runway in front. MASKS (2026-11-06): both wings' outer leading edges at FS 480-504 run across the treeline. STORES (seen in the stores pass, 2026-11-08): 1: LAU-7 with an AIM-9M-type round (large double-delta canards forward, large tail wings); live or captive training round cannot be told; its nose runs out of the frame; 2: bare SUU-63 (nose seen just right of the radome); 3: 330-gal tank (black-painted nose cone with chipped paint) on an SUU-63 (pylon front not identifiable); 4: no missile seen; 5: LITENING targeting pod on its centreline adapter; 6: no missile; 7: SUU-63 and 330-gal tank; 8: bare SUU-63; 9: LAU-7, empty.

dvids9820810.notes: Close shot, strong perspective (the nose is relatively larger than in dvids9820801). Canopy closed, pilot aboard. The gun muzzle slot is cut into the top of the nose at the radome joint: the circumferential seam runs down the side from the slot's aft lower corner, and meets the top silhouette at the slot's aft tip, so radome_top = slot aft tip and gun_port = centroid of the slot opening (slot runs ~4549-4632 px), i.e. the port is just ahead of the joint as the brief says. Probe door = long panel on the upper right nose ahead of the windscreen; its lower edge runs from probe_door_aft to probe_door_front. canopy_aft = where the canopy's aft edge line (which comes down to sill_aft_right) meets the top silhouette, ~70 px aft of where the glass ends (+-4 px, least sure). Canopy outline is the thin dark top line of the transparent glass (no snap). Sill edge is the centre of the dark canopy/fuselage gap line (no snap). axle_nose_right = centre of the near nose wheel hub rings. The left nose wheel hub is hidden behind the strut; inlet not visible (below LEX, behind stores). nose_bottom stops at x 4600: a fairing under the nose at ~4300-4450. STORES (seen in the stores pass, 2026-11-08): 1: not seen; 2: not seen; 3: not seen; 4: not seen; 5: LITENING pod adapter edge only, past the right tank (as in dvids9820808); 6: no missile; 7: SUU-63 (nose hidden behind station 8's) and 330-gal tank (front half in frame); 8: bare SUU-63 (front half in frame); 9: LAU-7 rail, forward fairing only in frame (red lens), no missile at its front.

dvids9820801.notes: Firefighters in the foreground hide the tail cone, nozzles, hook, stabilator and nose gear; nothing marked near them. Below y~1230 the sky-facing edge right of the near fin is the FAR (left) fin's leading edge (offset ~55 px right of the near fin's LE line); the near fin's LE is only against sky above y~1215. fin_tip_leading_left is the far fin's top-forward corner peeking above; its trailing corner is hidden. fin_tip_leading_right is on the rounded tip corner (intersection of the top-edge and LE lines is ~2 px outside it, at (2879,1037)). fin_right_trailing includes the rudder's trailing edge (rudder looks neutral). apex +-4 px: the radome's lower side is in shadow against dark trees. radome_top / gun_port: same construction as dvids9820810 (slot aft tip on the silhouette; centroid of the slot opening). Canopy outline = thin glass edge against sky (no snap), skipping the bow at x~6400 where the frame sits a few px below the glass line. canopy_aft +-4 px (where the canopy aft edge line leaves the top silhouette). light_strip_* = the formation-light strip corners also marked in dvids9820810 and dvids9820799. STORES (seen in the stores pass, 2026-11-08): 1: not seen; 2: not seen; 3: not seen (behind the right tank); 4: not seen; 5: LITENING pod on its centreline adapter (dome head seen past the right tank's nose); 6: no missile; 7: SUU-63 and 330-gal tank; 8: bare SUU-63; 9: LAU-7 rail, empty (no missile).

dvids9820748.notes: Camera ahead of the jet's left side, roughly 35-40 deg off the nose, above the LEX (its top surface shows) and below the canopy top. Photo-right = aft and aircraft-left; the photo-right fin is the left fin. DEFLECTIONS: leading-edge flaps drooped, roughly 10-20 deg by eye (the LEF's inboard end stands below the LEX edge at the junction, x 4715-4915); trailing-edge flaps and ailerons drooped well down, roughly 30-40 deg (their lower surfaces hang as a dark band below the wing, the aileron's outboard edge a diagonal from about 6952,3172 to 7015,3275); the left stabilator's outboard tip shows past the wingtip (white, x 6955-7305, y 3115-3220) with its tip edge rising steeply to the trailing corner, consistent with trailing-edge-up roughly 5-12 deg as in dvids9820756; rudders not judged. Hook down (not marked); canopy closed. The silhouette box centre is y 2625.5 (crown 2450, ground 2801), nudged 5 px down for tyre deflection: the 29.5 in tyre's free radius at the track's 12.3 px/in (wheel centres 1280 and 2813) puts the axle 181 px below the crown, at 2631. Leading-edge flaps not visible. The rest are +-3 px. OUT OF THE SOLVE (2026-11-01): taken from directly behind with the engines running, through the exhaust: its camera fits the other photos' points at 30 px rms with misses running opposite ways at different heights across the frame, and no single mark explains it (leaving any one out leaves 23-31 px); the marker saw heat haze blur a fin tip and one tyre image 8% smaller than the other. navy100303N3038W144.notes: SIDES: seen from behind (both nozzles face the camera with afterburner flame; the canopy is small and far, beyond the fins) and upright in the frame (fins up, gear hanging below), so the aircraft's left is on the photo's left. The top of the jet is seen (canopy above the spine, modex 400 on both wing tops, the right tank half hidden under its wing), banked right wing up about 12 deg in the frame. The photo-right fin shows its outer face (NH lettering), consistent with a camera right of the axis. Swapping left and right fails the solve (rms 9.2 px with the camera thrown to infinity, against 3.0). VIEW: behind, about 8 deg above the wing plane and 9 deg right of the axis (solo camera 124 m off, focal 42,300 px). POSE: gear down (struts fully extended in the air: the right main wheel's centre is at (2823,1823), about 0.4 m below the model's gear-down wheel at oleo 0, so no gear marks); hook up (not seen); nozzles open (afterburner; the exit outlines match the model's open nozzles); flaps down 0.53 (fold_trailing_left fits 0.53: half flap, fairly sure); ailerons drooped less than the flaps, given as joints: aileron_left 0.22 (wingtip_trailing_left fits it to 1.4 px), aileron_right 0.12 (wingtip_trailing_right, 15 px miss in x), possibly with some roll input; stabilators trailing edge up about 0.13 (both seen nearly edge-on as thin planks, so their trailing-edge-up angle is close to the camera's elevation; the tip positions alone, through the solo camera, would give left -0.12, right -0.06; +-0.05); slat not seen (0.209 assumed, the take-off schedule); load 1. MARKS: fin tips: intersections of half-intensity lines fitted along the tip edge and the leading and trailing edges (line rms 0.1-0.6 px); the corners are slightly rounded, +-2 px. pod_aft_*: centre of the round blunt aft end of the upper pod on each fin's trailing edge, seen nearly end-on (the first of three bumps below the tip), +-3 px. canopy_crown: the bubble outline's extreme along the jet's up direction is at (2295,563); seen from 8 deg above, that silhouette point lies about 0.25 m forward of the crown, so the mark is moved by the model canopy profile's offset (-10,+7) px to (2285,570); treat as +-6 px. lex_fence_top_*_left: the left fence plate is clear against the sky; corners from fitted aft, top and front edges (+-3 px, rounded). The real fence leans aft (its aft and front edges rake back going up, about 0.3 m and 0.55 m over its 0.21 m height), unlike the model's near-vertical edges. nozzle_exit_bottom_left: the lower rim's outline against the sky, at its extreme along the jet's down direction (0.225,0.974) in the image: the bottom is flat, so +-10 px along it, +-2 across; a circle fitted to the lower-left rim puts the exit centre at (1807,1648), about 45 px right of the model's nozzle axis. stabilator tips: each stabilator is a thin plank seen nearly edge-on; the left plank's outboard point is its trailing corner, the right plank's its leading corner (the other corner lies inside the plank), half-intensity extremes. wingtip_trailing_*: aileron tip trailing corners from fitted tip and trailing edges (left behind wingtip vapour, +-3; right partly behind the AIM-9's fin, +-5). fold_trailing_left: the flap's outboard trailing corner at the flap/aileron gap (gap edge x flap trailing edge, +-2). STORES: 1 an empty wingtip launch rail (no missile; given as pylon - the pylon box sits below the mount, so a box round the rail itself may be wanted); 2 a finned missile hanging under the left outer wing (its aft end ~100 px inboard of station 2's projection, 300 px from station 3's); 7 a tank (its aft end ~125 px outboard of station 7's projection, far from 8's); 8 an empty pylon's aft end below the 400 on the right outer wing; 9 an AIM-9. Stations 3, 4, 5, 6 hidden (behind the wing, nozzles and fuselage): left to the default. MASKS: vapour off the left wingtip and round its rail. NOT MARKED: fin_root_leading_*: the leading edges run white on white into the body, no junction visible. lex_fence_*_right: white on the white LEX, only an unexplained grey strip shows. lex_wing_*, lex_apex_*, inlets, splitters, pitots, aoa, apex, gun port, radome, probe door, blade_nose: hidden under the LEX and nose or on featureless silhouettes. antenna_dorsal_tip_front: a thin dark line (2097,820)-(2120,905) under a white knob at (2087,795) may be the blade, but it bends into a panel line at its foot, so it is not trusted. canopy_aft, sills, bow feet, windscreen: the canopy's lower part is hidden behind the spine. nozzle_exit_bottom_right: its lower rim is confused by a dark tab and the left main gear strut. hook: stowed, hidden. axles and wheels: see POSE. LEAST SURE: depth. The forward fixed marks are only canopy_crown (corrected silhouette) and the left fence; the solo focal (42,300 px) is about 1.9x the EXIF's (120 mm on a D300 = 21,800 px), and held at the EXIF focal the fixed marks fit at rms 10.1 px. Through the solo camera the tail-end moving marks sit ~20 px inboard of the model (stabilator tips, right wingtip) and the nozzle 36 px. Either the image is a crop enlarged to the D300's native size, or the canopy and fence marks bias the depth. SOLO: camera.solve on the 9 fixed marks (fin tips, pods, canopy_crown, left fence); rms over those only. The moving marks (nozzle, stabilator tips, wingtips, fold) are not in the solve: their residuals are the model posed as above, through that camera. The other two photos by this photographer (N3038W) also solve at about twice their EXIF focal (navy100228N3038W197 at ~37,000 px against 18,500), so their EXIF focal looks unusable as a prior. MERGE (main session): the moving marks kept aside, not in the solve: the aileron overrides were fitted to the wingtip corners and the flap to the fold corner, so they carry no information; the stabilator tips miss by 20-21 px, the pattern the gate carries as known for oblique in-flight cameras; the open nozzle's exit misses by 37 px with its size a pose guess. The empty wingtip rail on station 1 is boxed as a tip missile, since a pylon's box sits below the mount and the model carries no rail. The camera is behind, about 8 deg above the wing plane and 9 deg right of the axis (the canopy shows above the spine between the fins), not below as the manifest first said. The canopy crown kept aside after the first gate run: from behind, the outline's top is a grazing point about 0.25 m ahead of the crown, and the mark was moved onto the crown with the model's own canopy profile, so it is not independent of the model; with it the crown's triangulation failed the gate (2.9 in along the stations). ASIDE (marked, left out of the solve): {"nozzle_exit_bottom_left": [1832.0, 1807.0], "stabilator_tip_trailing_left": [779.0, 1825.5], "stabilator_tip_leading_right": [3070.0, 1358.0], "wingtip_trailing_left": [226.7, 1781.5], "wingtip_trailing_right": [3963.7, 982.3], "fold_trailing_left": [822.0, 1755.3], "canopy_crown": [2285.0, 570.0]} LEFT OUT OF THE SOLVE: with the crown set aside, its eight marks lie between FS 383 and 657 and cannot hold its depth: the bundle moved its camera from 124 m to 412 m (field 1.8 deg). It needs a forward landmark the view shows, and none does: the nose, the LEX apexes and the windscreen are hidden, and the canopy's aft end shows no corner.

navy100228N3038W197.notes: SIDES: the jet comes straight at the camera nose first (radome, canopy and both intakes face the lens; gear, hook and drooped flaps hang below), and we see a little of its underside, not its top (intakes and gear bays visible, canopy seen from below its crown). So the aircraft's LEFT is the photo's RIGHT: left fin, left intake and left wing (station 1 tip missile) on the photo's right. Consistent with the solve: the camera comes out ahead, 6.4 deg below and 5 deg to the aircraft's right, and only that side's LEX fence stands clear of its LEX edge. VIEW: head-on from about 115-120 m with a very long lens (focal about 37000 px), jet rolled about 2 deg left (left wing low), hazy backlight, sea and deck behind the gear. POSE: gear down (in flight, oleos fully extended), hook down, full flaps. Flaperon values are what put the model's flap outboard trailing corner (fold_trailing) on the photo's: right 0.87, left 1.0 (left fits to 4 px, right to 11 px, the model's flap edge sitting about 11 px inboard of the photo's); larger than the real 45 deg limit, so the model's flap hinge does not reproduce the slotted flap's travel exactly - treat them as fitted, not measured angles. The ailerons droop much less than the flaps, so they are given apart under pose.joints (aileron_right 0.48, fits its tip corner to 1 px; aileron_left 0.475, to 13 px); the single flaperon drive cannot hold both, and wingtip_trailing_* only fit with those joints. Slat 0.2 is a nominal on-speed value, not measured (the leading-edge flap's tip corner is hidden by the tip launcher). Stabilators are hidden behind the drooped flaps: -0.1 is a guess and affects no mark. Nozzles are not visible (approach power, guessed closed). MARKS: apex = the sun glint on the radome's small rounded tip, which also lies on the shading terminator that runs through the tip (+-8 px). Fin tips: leading = the topmost point of each fin's silhouette, by intersecting the leading-edge and tip-chord half-intensity lines; trailing = the slope break where the tip chord turns into the trailing edge on the outboard side of the silhouette (right fin a clear shoulder; left fin a gentle break, +-8 px). Inlet lips: the centre of the lit lip band from luminance profiles across it (top, outer and bottom of each D-shaped intake); outer = the outermost point of the band, top/bottom = its highest/lowest, placed along the nearly flat top and bottom where the band is extreme (+-15 px along the edge, +-3 across). LEX fence (right): the two top corners of the fence plate where it stands clear above the LEX edge against the sky (front = upper right, aft = upper left). lex_apex_right: where the dark LEX underside's leading edge ends against the light forebody (blurred, +-8 px). bow_foot_right: the windscreen frame's dark line runs down to y 410 and meets a 20 px dark sill band; marked mid-band (+-8 px). fold_trailing: the flap's outboard trailing corner at the flap/aileron gap (daylight shows through the gap), crisp. wingtip_trailing: the aileron's outboard trailing corner, crisp. NOT MARKED: canopy crown and bow top (head-on, the canopy's silhouette top lies between them, neither is a feature); windscreen base, sill_aft, bow_foot_left (overexposed sunlit side), pitot and AoA probes (seen end-on, invisible against the nose), lex_apex_left and lex fence left (hidden behind the radome and inside the LEX silhouette), splitters and inlet corners (the inner side of each intake is indistinct), fin roots (behind the wing), pod_aft (head-on the pod's aft end is hidden behind its front), wingtip_leading (behind the tip launcher), stabilators (behind the flaps), hook (set by deck contact). The four wheel centres (middle of each tyre seen head-on) are under 'aside', not marks: with gear 1 the model puts every wheel 0.4-0.5 m (125-170 px) higher than the photo, the in-flight oleo extension, and no oleo setting fixed it in a quick scan; use them only once the gear's in-flight extension is posed. STORES: AIM-9 on both tips (fins visible), empty pylons outboard (stations 2/8, seen against the flaps), tanks inboard, a round pod nose about 0.3 m across under the left intake (station 4, likely a FLIR pod), nothing on the centreline or under the right intake. LEAST SURE: the intake lips' along-edge positions and the solve's systematic inlet residuals (the model's intakes come out about 10 px narrower and taller than the lip bands), the left fin's trailing tip corner, the apex glint, bow_foot_right; residuals past 8 px were re-checked in the photo and kept for those reasons. MERGE (main session): the flap and aileron trailing corners (fold_trailing_*, wingtip_trailing_*) kept aside, not in the solve: their pose was fitted to those same corners and runs past the flaps' 45 deg travel, so they carry no information and could pull the shared points. ASIDE (marked, left out of the solve): {"wheel_nose_right": [2277, 1366], "wheel_nose_left": [2420, 1366], "wheel_main_right": [1700, 1545], "wheel_main_left": [2690, 1592], "fold_trailing_right": [934.5, 1073.0], "fold_trailing_left": [3379.0, 1188.0], "wingtip_trailing_right": [381.0, 946.0], "wingtip_trailing_left": [3920.5, 1087.5]} STORES (seen in the stores pass, 2026-11-08): 1: LAU-7 with an AIM-9-class round seen nose-on, short stubby fins; variant not determinable; 2: SUU-63, seen end-on below the wing, nothing hanging from it; 3: 330-gal tank (seen end-on, dark disc); 4: a round-fronted store about 15 in across under the left inlet, most likely an ATFLIR pod; not certain; 5: nothing seen below the belly (the nose gear fills the view); 6: not distinguishable under the right inlet; 7: 330-gal tank (seen end-on, dark disc); 8: SUU-63, seen end-on below the wing, nothing hanging from it; 9: LAU-7 with an AIM-9-class round seen nose-on, four long thin fins in an X; variant not determinable.

dvids7243901.notes: SIDES: nose to the photo's left, canopy on top (upright, seen a little from below), and 'VMFA(AW)-533', 'MARINES' and the star-and-bar read normally, so this is the aircraft's LEFT side; the right fin shows only as its top peeking out ahead of and below the left fin, and the right pitot tube shows below the nose outline. dvids9437764.notes: SIDES: underside view, nose to photo upper-left. Seen from below, the aircraft's right is the photo's lower-left wing and its left the upper-right wing. Checks: the stores hang toward the camera and the canopy is hidden, so the view is from below; the tank stencil 'STARTS HERE' on the station-7 tank reads left to right, so the photo is not mirrored; only one fin shows, beyond the upper-right edge of the body, and a sliver of canopy glass shows past the upper-right LEX edge, so the camera sits off the jet's left, which is that side; every solve puts the eye below the wing plane (y about -147 m) and to the left (z about -106 m). No star-and-bar is legible under either wing (low-visibility paint). VIEW: from below, ahead and left of the jet (solved eye about (+102, -147, -106) m, 208 m away). Canon EOS R6 Mark II, RF100-500 at 363 mm per EXIF, about 60,600 px focal; the free solve gives 51,900, and an EXIF-focal solve gives the same residual pattern. Clear blue sky throughout, no vapour. POSE: gear up, hook stowed. Nozzles closed (nozzle 1): no burner glow, the nozzles taper, and the closed-nozzle exit bottoms project onto the photo's nozzle ends while the open (rest) exit rings overhang the outline by about 40 px. Stabilators 0.0 (+-0.03; moderate confidence): both tip chords measure parallel to the fuselage axis in the photo (dx/dy 0.997 and 1.010 against 0.993 apex-to-hook; 0.1 rad would make it about 0.87). Ailerons from the slope of each aileron's outboard edge near its tip (about 45 px of edge, sky between it and the rail): left about +0.14 (TE down), right about -0.28 (TE up), so the jet is rolling; low to moderate confidence. These are given as pose.joints overrides. Flaps: the left flap's outboard edge slope gives about +0.11 and the free fit gives 0.15-0.25; the right flap gives about 0 to +0.07 (from a short edge and the trailing-edge step); low confidence. They are well short of the 0.52 launch setting, so the flaps were probably already up or on AUTO. Slat: the inner LEF's inboard end stands about 14 px clear of the LEX's aft tip, a gap a drooped LEF opens; 0.1 is a low-confidence guess (fits give 0.07-0.17). Load 1, though the jet is in a climbing turn. MARKS (all line fits at the half level between sky and surface, b-r channel, unless said): apex: the radome tip (+-1.5). pitot_tip_right: end of the L-probe's forward tube on the lower-left outline, at half the tube's core contrast (+-2). lex_apex_left: the forward tip of the shadowed LEX underside where it leaves the lit forebody (+-2). lex_fence_top_front_left: the fence stands above the left LEX edge against the sky. Its top front corner is rounded (radius about 6 px), so the mark is where the lines of its raked front edge and straight top edge meet; the material's corner is about 4 px inside (+-4). lex_wing_right: the inboard leading corner of the inner LEF, where its leading edge reaches the gap to the LEX's aft tip. The LEX edge runs on about 14 px further, to (2235, 1750), and the two edge lines would meet at (2228, 1741.5) (+-5). inlet_corner_bottom_right: where the line fits of the dark right intake opening's inboard boundary, above and below its rounded right end, meet. The end itself is at (2394.5, 1825) (+-6). fin_tip_trailing_left: the left fin's top trailing corner, where the tip edge (sky above it) meets the trailing edge. The trailing edge is traced over rows 2100-2340 (fixed fin and rudder collinear, so the rudder is not toed in), and its extension passes the corner within 1 px (+-3). pod_aft_left: the blunt aft end of the white cylinder on the fin's trailing edge 0.2 m below the tip (the upper pod; a second, lower cylinder ends at (3802, 2070)). It stands about 28 px aft of the trailing-edge line (+-4). hook_point: aft tip of the dark stowed hook shoe between the nozzles (+-4). wingtip_leading_right: where the wing's leading edge meets the inner edge of the empty LAU-7 rail. The true corner may lie up to about 15 px further along the leading edge, under the rail (+-10 along the leading edge, +-2 across). wingtip_trailing_right and wingtip_trailing_left: the trailing-edge line meets the aileron's outboard edge (sky between the edge and the rail); slight rounding (+-3). fold_trailing_right and fold_trailing_left: the flap's outboard edge at the flap/aileron notch meets the flap's trailing edge (+-3). stabilator_tip_leading_left and _right: the leading-edge line meets the straight tip-edge line, a nearly sharp corner (+-2). NOT MARKED: wingtip_leading_left (the rail lies over the tip there; the leading edge meets the rail at (3925, 1461) but the corner is hidden). stabilator_tip_trailing_* (heavily rounded; virtual corners at (4390.7, 2650.7) left and (3120.7, 3233.7) right, 50-60 px outside the material; they fit to 5-7 px). nozzle_exit_bottom_* (seen from below, the bottom flap's exit point lies part way along the rim arc with no visible feature; the lower outline-rim corners are at about (3725, 2841) and (3537, 2915)). Inlet lip points (smooth curves, no corner; the left lip is a lit white C). lex_wing_left and lex_fence_top_aft_left (behind the station-3 tank). lex_apex_right (no apex shows on the lower-left outline). Right fin, canopy and windscreen points (hidden or only a sliver of glass). fin_tip_leading_left and fin_root_leading_left (behind the left wing's trailing edge). hook_pivot (indistinct). aoa_left (a white tab and streak at (1600-1617, 646-660), its root not on the outline). blade_nose_bottom_* and pitot_tip_left (not resolved). Splitters (behind the centreline pod's head). STORES: 1 and 9 empty LAU-7 tip rails, no missiles (kept as tip missile so the box covers the rails, which reach about 1 m ahead of the wing). 2 and 8 each carry one long bomb on an outboard pylon: 8 is a laser-guided type with a seeker and canards, 2 has a rounded nose and red bands; the missile box is the nearest kind. 3 and 7 tanks; 5 the targeting pod on the centreline between the nacelles; 4 and 6 empty. No masks: every store overlapping the outline is inside its station's box. LEAST SURE / CONFLICT: with any single camera the fin and stabilator tips disagree with the rest of the marks, and I confirmed each in the photo. fin_tip_trailing_left fits 29 px (pod 18) and the stabilators' leading tip corners 24-32 px. The fit uses the pose above, all marks, focal free; with the EXIF focal, or with load 0-3, a vertical scale, or k1 free, the result is the same. Freeing the stabilators fits their corners only at +0.2 rad trailing edge down, which their tip chords rule out. The pattern reads as the photo's fin trailing edge lying about 0.1 m forward of the model's: the corner lands 23 px forward, the pod's aft end close, and the pod stands 0.13 m clear of the edge here against the model's 0.045. It also reads as the stabilators' leading tip corners lying about 0.1 m aft of and 0.1 m below the model's at zero deflection. A fixed-only solve (the 8 fixed marks plus the hook, EXIF focal) reaches 8.8 px rms, but its camera rolls about the fuselage axis and misses the wing and stabilator marks by 20-50 px. MERGE (main session): the stabilator tips kept aside, not in the solve: they sit about 0.1 m aft and below the model's with the tips' edges showing no deflection, the pattern the gate already carries as known for oblique in-flight cameras (the stabilators' leading corners), which moved this camera 20-30 px. MERGE (main session, after the first gate run): wingtip_leading_right kept aside: the corner lies under the empty LAU-7 rail and the mark is where the leading edge meets the rail's inner edge, up to 15 px inboard of the corner (about 2.4 in at 208 m); with it the corner triangulated 2.6 in inboard and failed the gate. ASIDE (marked, left out of the solve): {"stabilator_tip_leading_left": [4235.4, 2489.8], "stabilator_tip_leading_right": [2958.6, 3070.1], "wingtip_leading_right": [1732.5, 2461.0]} SIGMA 9 px: its marks fit at about 9 px rms in the bundle (the fin and stabilator tips disagree with the rest under any single camera), against the default 2.4 px. At the default it pulled the wing and LEX points it shares with dvids9820744 and moved that photo's wing_left_leading edge from 1.17 to 1.51 in, past the gate; at its own rms the edge is back to 1.17 in. LEFT OUT OF THE SOLVE after the sky check: even at sigma 9 its camera fits the nose and misses the tail, the stabilators 20-40 px off along their whole length in its overlay (median miss 1.93 in, 56% past 1.5 in, against 0.45-1.1 in for the rest); the only regions it alone judged (body FS 528-576 lower side) it read about 8 in inside.

c70801476.notes: JET: No. 2, the bottom jet of the four (yellow '2' on its fin, serial 163451 on the aft fuselage). SIDES: nose to the photo's left, upright (canopy above, fin up); 'U.S.NAVY', 'Blue Angels' and the '2' read correctly, so its left side faces the camera. The camera is about 14 deg below the wing plane, decided from occlusion: the wing drawn above the fuselage has its leading edge (a thin highlight) starting at the LEX junction (3369, 2577), below the spine outline, then crossing the fuselage side and the spine, and the wing hides the spine aft of x 3575, so that wing is in front: the near, LEFT wing; the lower wing's leading edge comes out from behind the fuselage's bottom outline at (3500, 2840), so it is behind: the far, RIGHT wing; only one fin shows (from below the right fin falls inside the left one); the near LEX fence's upper part shows above the near LEX edge, its base cut off by that edge. So the upper tip rail and upper stabilator are LEFT, the lower ones RIGHT. The upper (near) tips sit aft of the lower ones (rails 225-232 px, stabilator tips about 151 px), so the camera is forward of the beam. VIEW: left side, about 14 deg below, about 7 deg forward of the beam, long lens. No. 1 (inverted) hangs its fin tip over No. 2's canopy: masked (polygon round No. 1's fin from y 2380 down to its tip, with a few px of padding). POSE: gear up. Hook up (the stowed claw shows as a round knob between the nozzles at about (4700-4722, 2700-2737); not marked, the landmark's point on the claw is unclear). Nozzles: only the near exit's aft edge shows (vertical at x about 4720 from 2603 to 2697, top hidden behind the left stabilator, petals not resolved); 1 (closed) is a guess from formation power, low confidence. Flaps and ailerons: the far wing's trailing edge runs straight from the fuselage outline (3922, 2842) to the rail with no visible break; inboard flaps hidden; 0, low to moderate confidence. Leading-edge flaps: no reference, 0, unknown. Stabilators: both tip chords lie within 0.016 (left) and 0.009 (right) rad of the fin top's direction, trailing end lower: about +0.01 to +0.02 TE down, low confidence. STORES: empty tip rails on both tips: upper (left, station 1) from (3625, 2413) to (4125, 2380), lower (right, station 9) from (3400, 2945) to (3893, 2906). No pylons under the near wing (its underside is in view) or the far wing; nothing on the centreline or body stations (only the blade under the nose, an angled blade under the forward fuselage at x 2840, and a yellow bulge under the nose at x 2480). MARKS: apex = the radome's rounded tip, y on the bisector of the upper and lower edges. blade_nose_bottom_* = corners of the fitted front, aft and bottom edges of the blade under the nose. lex_fence_top_* = top corners of the trapezoidal fence outline (a light line; its centre). lex_wing_left = where the wing leading edge's highlight leaves the lower edge of the LEX's bright edge band. antenna_dorsal_tip_front = corner of the fitted front and top edges of the tall yellow blade; antenna_spine_tip_front = front-top corner of the small 12x8 px blade at x 3314 (+-1.5). bow_foot_left = centre of the 25 px bow frame (front edge 2577, aft edge 2602) where it meets the canopy sill (glass bottom 2524, sill 2527); +-10 px along the frame. splitter_bottom_right = lower corner of the small step in the bottom outline at x 3213 (the far splitter's lower front corner, below the forebody). inlet_lip_bottom_right = where the far inlet's rounded lower lip meets the bottom line (outline steps down at x 3342-3360; +-5). fin_tip_* = intersections of the fitted top edge with the leading edge and with the trailing edge just below the tip. pod_aft_left = half-intensity aft end of the upper (yellow) pod. Stabilator tips (moving) = intersections of the fitted tip-chord line with the leading-edge line (obtuse corner, +-3) and the trailing-edge line (acute: the visible rounded tips end 44 px short at 4868 on the left and 22 px short at 4735 on the right; +-5). NOT MARKED: near wingtip corners and near trailing edge (rail; dark on dark), near inlet, splitters' tops, LEX apex, sill_aft (no edges in the near-black side; the canopy rear is a thin sliver), right fin and pods (behind the left fin), pitot and AoA (not resolved), gun_port (faired over). SOLVE: the fixed marks alone give rms 5.6 (camera about 780 m), but they are all near-side or near the centreline, so the yaw is free: that camera puts the far stabilator tips 62-64 px forward of the photo's and a near-to-far offset of about 32 px per metre of span, where the tip rails show 19-20 and the stabilator tips 23. With the four stabilator tips added the solve goes orthographic at rms 12.4 with systematic residuals: the model's fin tips 13-20 px aft of the photo's, its stabilator tips 7-15 px forward and 5-14 px high, apex 15. Scaling from the apex without the solver, the fin, fence and centreline antennas give about 173 px/m along the body while the stabilator tips and the near nozzle exit sit 30-60 px further aft than that scale puts the model's. The photo's upper fin pod sticks out about 14 px (0.08 m) aft of the fin's trailing corner; the model's pod_aft is flush with it. Worst fixed residuals, looked at again and kept: bow_foot_left 11.4 (frame centre; the model's line falls near the frame's aft edge), apex 8.0 (tip is clear), pod_aft_left 7.8 (edge is clear), lex_wing_left 7.7. LEAST SURE: splitter_bottom_right and inlet_lip_bottom_right (which part makes each outline step), bow_foot_left, the stabilator trailing corners (long extrapolation), the nozzle state. MERGE (main session): the stabilator tips kept aside, not in the solve: with them the solve ran to an orthographic camera at rms 12.4 px, the pattern the gate carries as known for oblique in-flight cameras. c61468204.notes: JET: No. 5 (BuNo 163451 on the aft fuselage, 5 on the fin), the large jet in the upper half; the other jets and the tanker are not marked. The fin carrying the big 5 is nearer: larger, higher and overlapping the second fin, which shows to its left (aft) and lower, as a far fin does from behind. The jet sits well above the hazy horizon, so the camera is below it: the near wing shows its gold underside with the gold wingtip launcher rail along its outer edge, standing above the fuselage, and the dorsal blade antenna pokes above the spine outline. So near = right: the 5 fin is fin_right, the visible wing and rail are the right wing and station 9. VIEW: from the right, behind (about 25 deg aft of the beam) and below (about 8 deg), close (solo camera about 20 m away, f about 3650 px, a wide lens) through a tanker window; strong perspective. POSE: gear up, hook stowed (its shank is visible lying along the belly ahead of the nozzles). Nozzle 1 (low confidence): the right nozzle's external flaps taper slightly toward the exit, no afterburner; cruise power waiting to refuel. Flaperons and slats 0 (not readable: the near wing's trailing edge is a confusing gold bar half behind the fin, and the leading edge band is crossed by window reflections; formation cruise). Stabilators 0.10 trailing edge down, low confidence: with the solo camera the right stabilator's trailing tip (aside) fits stabilator.right 0.10 (its tip chord shows as a thin gold-edged sliver about 50 px below the rest pose); the left one's visible tip fits about 0.0 in height but sits 29 px aft-wise off the camera, so the camera is weak out there (all fixed marks lie within the fins' span) and I give both the right's value. Stores: station 9 carries the gold wingtip rail; the right wing (stations 7, 8), the right fuselage station 6 and the centreline 5 are clearly bare; stations 1-4 are hidden behind the fuselage (1 assumed a rail as on every team jet). MARKS: apex = the radome's pointed tip where the upper and lower outlines meet. Blade = the dark rectangular antenna under the nose at x 3619-3639: its two bottom corners, from half-intensity lines of the side and bottom edges (front = right, nose side). antenna_dorsal_tip_front = the gold swept blade on the spine behind the canopy, sticking above the outline: top edge (y 622) meets the leading edge (slope 0.4 px/px), sharp. Fin tips = corners of the gold fin caps: right leading corner from the cap's top edge and swept leading edge (slightly rounded, +-2 px); right and left trailing corners where the cap's top edge meets its aft edge. Pods = the blunt aft end of the upper (gold) antenna pod on each fin's trailing edge, on its axis. NOT MARKED: canopy aft, sill aft and LEX fences hidden behind the near wing's rail and underside; the far LEX, far wing, far inlet and far fin's leading tip hidden behind the fuselage or near fin; inlet lip and splitter points are not corners in this view (the lip shows only as a straight vertical front edge at x 2822; a splitter edge at x 2870 is too faint); gun port faired over; pitot/AoA see aside; canopy crown only the outline top. ASIDE (not for the solve): bow_foot_right = where the near leg of the windscreen bow meets the sill, read at the top of the gold sill stripe (the window's lower rim is at y 720, the stripe's top at 727); the solo camera puts the model's foot 14 px aft and 14 px lower (20 px), i.e. in the middle of the stripe, and photo dvids2211572 shows the same offset, so it is a question of which sill edge the model's foot means. bow_top = the top of the bow arch on the outline (+-10 px along it, an outline extremum; the solo camera puts the model's 22 px aft). hook_pivot = the forward end of the lit hook shank, where it meets its fairing; the pivot itself is inside (model's 15 px forward). pitot_tip_right = the forward end of a dark tube on the lower nose outline, which starts at about the model's pitot tip and runs 45 px further forward; possibly the real pitot is longer than the model's, not certain it is the pitot. wingtip_trailing_right = the aileron's outboard trailing corner, a gold wedge pointing aft just inboard of the rail's aft end (moving part; model's 27 px forward at rest). Stabilator trailing tips: right = the left end of the thin gold-edged sliver; left = the vertex of the far stabilator's lower-surface triangle against the sky (both moving, see POSE). MASK: a bright window reflection streak crossing the nose's top outline at x 3690-3760. Other reflections lie inside the outline (on the wing underside) or fade before reaching it; nothing marked lies under any. clear = true: blue sky behind the whole jet (the window reflections are masked or inside the outline). LEAST SURE: antenna_dorsal_tip_front (8.5 px; the corner is crisp gold on sky, re-read from both edges, confirmed) and the far fin pair: in both photos the left fin's pod sticks out about 10 px further aft of the cap's trailing corner than the model's (pod_aft_left 7.5, fin_tip_trailing_left 6.5 px, pulling opposite ways), confirmed in the crops; the right pod does not. dvids2211565.notes: JET: No. 6 ('6' on the fin, serial 163442). SIDES: nose to the photo's left, upright (canopy above, fins up); 'U.S.NAVY', 'Blue Angels', '6' and the serial read correctly, so its left side faces the camera. Two fin caps show at the top: the bright yellow one fills its whole cap and covers the other, so it is the near, LEFT fin; the olive-yellow cap that shows only ahead of the near fin's leading edge, 4.5 px lower and 33 px forward, is the far, RIGHT fin. Lower means the camera is slightly below the wing plane (about 1 deg); forward means the camera is forward of the beam (about 5 deg). The wings and stabilators are edge-on; the tip rail seen at y 960 is the left one. VIEW: left side, nearly level, panning shot; the jet sits wholly against a uniform hazy pale sky (runway and buildings well below, y > 1150); pitched about 3 deg nose up in the frame. POSE: gear up. Hook stowed (its shank shows under the tail, rising aft into the fuselage). Nozzles: the near exit is seen edge-on with petals: about 90 px (0.87 m) tall at the petal roots and 77 px (0.74 m) at the exit, a mild taper like the model's open rest shape (0.89 to 0.79 m); no afterburner glow visible in daylight; 0 (open), low to moderate confidence. The exit plane sits about 9 px (0.09 m) aft of the model's open rest exit. Flaps and ailerons: a 30 deg flap would hang about 30 px below the edge-on wing line over the 'VY' of U.S.NAVY and nothing is there; 0, moderate confidence. Leading-edge flaps: the leading edge is hidden in the rail; 0, unknown. Stabilators: the near stabilator's edge-on sliver ends at (2575, 1016), about 3 px below and 7 px aft of the rest pose under the fixed camera: near neutral, about +0.02 TE down, low confidence. STORES: left tip rail from (1820, 962) to (2128, 958). The right tip is not visible (behind the fuselage in this edge-on view); the team flies both rails, so 'tip missile'. No pylons below the edge-on near wing (one would cover the lettering under it); nothing under the fuselage but the nose blade, a yellow bump at (1160, 975), an angled blade at (1370, 1000) and the hook. MASK: a thin dark arc from (2412, 952) over to (2455, 963) above the near nozzle, off the jet's outline (not on the model; probably the smoke pipe). MARKS: apex = the radome's tip, y on the bisector of the upper and lower edges. aoa_left = the AoA probe's small round base, seen face-on at (1030.5, 919.5): the cone points at the camera, so root and tip coincide; it is not on the outline in this view. blade_nose_bottom_* = corners of the fitted blade edges. windscreen_base = intersection of the forebody's top outline line with the windscreen glass's top outline line (the junction is rounded over about 15 px; +-4). bow_top = top of the dark bow frame at the canopy outline; bow_foot_left = centre of the 14 px frame at the sill (+-7 along the frame). canopy_aft = where the glass's top line meets the yellow spine stripe (with the camera 1 deg below, the top centreline is on the outline). lex_fence_top_* = centres of the light outline line at the fence's top corners. antennas = corners of the fitted front and top edges (the spine blade is 8x9 px, +-1.5). inlet_lip_bottom_right = intersection of the lip's front edge and the bottom line at the step in the outline; it is the forward-most lip, so the far one (the near lip's edge shows as a faint light line 8-12 px aft, inside the silhouette). fin_tip_* = intersections of the fitted top edges with the leading and trailing edges (the near fin's leading edge across the far cap is a yellow-on-olive boundary, +-1.5). pod_aft_left = aft end of the upper pod. hook_pivot = where the shank leaves the dark pivot fitting under the tail (+-5). nozzle_exit_bottom_left (moving) = bottom of the narrow exit ellipse (its right edge at x 2511, ellipse about 9 px wide). NOT MARKED: canopy_crown (a smooth maximum, no x), sill_aft (under the yellow stripe), lex_apex and lex_wing (blended, no corner), splitters (near and far 8-13 px apart and overlapping), wingtip corners (inside the rail; wing edge-on), stabilator tips (edge-on), far fin trailing corner and pods (behind the near fin), pitot (not resolved), gun_port (faired over). SOLVE: fixed marks rms 3.8 (camera about 300 m; the distance is weakly fixed). Worst: antenna_dorsal_tip_front 7.8 (the model's blade about 7 px aft of the photo's; the fitted edges are clear), bow_foot_left 5.7, pod_aft_left 5.3 (the photo's pod sticks out about 5 px aft of the fin's trailing corner; the model's is flush), antenna_spine_tip_front 5.0. nozzle_exit_bottom_left lies 12 px from the open rest prediction; adding it pushes the solve orthographic (rms 4.4). LEAST SURE: hook_pivot, bow_foot_left, the nozzle state, and whether the outline's lip step is the far lip. MERGE (main session): the nozzle exit kept aside: its open-or-closed state is a guess and with it the solve ran orthographic. ASIDE (marked, left out of the solve): {"nozzle_exit_bottom_left": [2507.0, 1053.5]} LEFT OUT OF THE SOLVE: solved within the gate (rms 3.1 px, field 6.7 deg), but its overlay reads the spine's top over FS 330-560 more than 2.5 in high, where the 13 side photos that judge that line put it within 0.5 in; its median miss is 1.33 in with 48% past 1.5 in. A level beam view whose distance is weakly held: until the disagreement is explained its readings stay out (2026-11-05). Tried again after the sky check learnt to read blue paint ("paint": "blue"), which had moved every Blue Angels reading outward: its top still reads 2.9 in outside against the other photos that judge the same regions (the other Blue Angels cameras -0.4 to +0.8), median miss 1.40 in. Not the paint: it stays out.

dvids2211572.notes: JET: No. 5 (BuNo 163451, 5 on the fin), alone in the frame. MARKS: apex = the radome's pointed tip. Below the fixed trailing-edge shroud on each wing hangs a band 55-60 px deep (the surfaces' lower surfaces), and the flap/aileron gap's side edge slants outboard as it runs down (aft and down), as a drooped surface's does; parked with flaps full and ailerons drooped. c82077610.notes: SIDES: the nose points to the photo's left and the jet is upright (canopy and both fins above the fuselage), so the side in view is its LEFT; the near fin (tiger) overlaps the far fin's leading edge, the red position lights near the left wingtip rail front (2590,1425) and on the left side at (2818,1432) are port red, and 'J-5011' reads normally on the near side. Fin tips = intersections of fitted top, leading and trailing edges against sky; fin_tip_leading_left is slightly rounded (the intersection sits 2-3 px outside the visible tip); fin_tip_leading_right's leading edge shows only 25 px above the near fin (direction less sure, +-3 px along the top edge). Moving: wingtip_trailing_left = where the left wing's trailing edge (fitted 3012-3060, slope 0.30) leaves the flat tip line at y 1387.7 (the rail ends at about x 2986, so this is the wing's own corner), +-4 px along x; fold_trailing_left = the small step in the trailing edge at the flap/aileron gap, outboard corner of the flap, +-5 px. ASIDE: windscreen_base is the slope break of the top silhouette (tangent lines meet at 1889.4); the break is gradual, so it is uncertain by about 10 px along the outline, and the model's point lies on the photo's outline 13 px further aft. radome_top = where the radome seam (a dark thin line at x 1630 at y 1410) meets the top silhouette, +-4 px; the model puts it 15 px aft. stabilator_tip_trailing_right is the visible extreme of the rounded tip, not the corner of the tip and trailing-edge lines (their fitted lines meet 80 px further out at 10 deg, so no reliable corner). inlet_lip_outer_left = leftmost point of the lit inlet cowl bulge; its height along the near-vertical lip is uncertain by 10 px. c114498618.notes: F/A-18D two-seater: no canopy, bow, sill or windscreen point marked. SIDES: nose photo-right; we see the belly (gear, tanks, intakes) with the canopy along the top edge of the fuselage, so the camera is below and to the jet's RIGHT, which puts the aircraft's right at photo-TOP: the right wing (upper, vortex trail from its tip), the right LEX fence standing above the upper outline, the right fin's outboard face above the aft fuselage, the right side of the forebody with its star-and-bar, pitot and AoA probe; the left wing, left stabilator and left wingtip are photo-bottom. Checked by handedness (looking up at the belly with the nose to the right, starboard is up the page) and by every solve: eye ahead, below and to the right (about (60..106, -64..-116, +74..+127) m). VIEW: from ahead, below and right; backlit (the belly is near-black, details read only with strong gamma). OUTLINE B: the LEFT nacelle's lower outboard edge between the left wing's trailing edge and the left stabilator is against clear sky (about x 1720-1950, y 1925-1975: the lower outline of the aft fuselage there, with the left stabilator's leading edge just aft of it); the RIGHT nacelle's corresponding outline lies against the right fin's light outboard face, not sky, so only the left one can judge B. POSE: gear down (nose and both mains), hook stowed (the shank lies along the belly between the nozzles, shoe at its aft end), launch bar up, nozzles read OPEN (exits about 0.8 m across at approach power, moderate). Flaps: gear-down approach, trailing-edge flaps clearly lowered but not measurable in the dark: 0.6 (low-moderate). Leading-edge flaps drooped (the right wing's leading edge meets the rail 30+ px off the undrooped model): 0.4, low. Ailerons drooped (the right wingtip trailing corner sits 9-33 px image-down of the model depending on the solve). Stabilators: both tip edges are rotated about 0.17-0.21 in slope against the undeflected model's projection, read as trailing edge UP about 0.2 rad each (moderate). MARKS (fixed): apex = nose tip (+-2). pitot_tip_right = forward tip of the right pitot tube (+-2). aoa_right = wide (root) end of the small dark AoA probe on the right forebody side (moderate: the probe is a small wedge; residual 1.6). lex_fence_top_*_right = fitted top edge with fitted front and aft edges of the right fence standing against the sky (sharp). splitter_top_right / splitter_bottom_right = top and bottom ends of the right splitter plate's front edge: the light plate seen between its dark front gap and the intake lip; top where the edge meets the LEX underside (+-3), bottom = intersection of the fitted (slightly curved) front edge and the plate's bottom edge (+-3). SOLO: the seven fixed marks all lie in the forward half (apex to the splitter), so the solo camera (rms 2.75, f 25467) is free in depth/focal and mispredicts the tail by 50-80 px. A second solve adding hook_point (stowed hook = rest pose, pose clear) anchors the tail: rms 3.64 over 8, f 45929, every fixed mark within 6.7 px (splitter_bottom_right worst); with it the stabilator tips fall within 19-26 px (leading) and the wingtip trailing corner 35 px, which is the expected pose effect. MOVING: hook_point = aft tip of the stowed hook shoe (white highlight at its end), pose clear (stowed, hook 0); wingtip_trailing_right = sharp corner where the right aileron's trailing edge meets a short tip edge running up to the rail (as in f53283332197), aileron drooped; stabilator_tip_leading_* = fitted leading and tip edges (sharp, +-2); stabilator_tip_trailing_* = intersections of fitted tip and trailing edges, both corners ROUNDED with a large radius (about 60 px), so +-30 along the tip edge. ASIDE: wingtip_leading_right (the leading edge meets the rail's underside; the true corner is under the rail; the LEF droop also moves it). NOT MARKED: right fin tips and pods (hidden behind the right wing's trailing edge: the two bulges visible below the wing at (1160, 1250) and (1162, 1278) are lower pods, not identifiable); left fin (hidden behind the fuselage); intake lips (the right lip is a soft curve with no corners; the left intake's D-shaped mouth is clear but its flat side does not match the splitter side's direction, so I could not tell which corner is which); blade_nose_bottom_* (a dark shape under the nose whose corners I could not map to the blade's); nozzle exits (open, but the bottom petal cannot be picked on the dark rim); left wingtip corners (behind the missile's fins); fold_trailing_* (dark). STORES: wingtip rails with AIM-9-shaped rounds on both tips (the left shows fins clearly; the right's fins are edge-on, so 9 is the less sure); large tanks on both inboard wing stations (3 and 7); a cylindrical pod on the fuselage under the right intake area (front at about (2660, 1515); taken as station 6, could be the centreline); no outboard pylons seen. MASKS: the wingtip vortex trails where they leave each wingtip and touch the outline. Background clear blue sky. LEAST SURE: the camera (all fixed marks forward; see SOLO), aoa_right's identity, store 6/5, every pose angle except gear and hook.
