VIEW: from below and slightly AHEAD, about 30 deg from straight below, nearly in the plane of symmetry, long lens. The planform corners alone fit a camera behind as well as ahead (planar twin); the fins decide it: from ahead their tips swing forward behind the wings and their trailing tips and tail pods show just outboard of the nacelles between wing and stabilator, which is what the photo shows; from behind they would sit behind the stabilators. Paint: busy 2024 display scheme (stars, maple leaf, false canopy, navy nose); only structure is marked: the radome tip, the vane roots, the fins' outline corners and pod lenses, the planform corners. The image is strongly sharpened and noisy (+-2-3 px on edges). POSE: gear up, hook stowed. Nozzles: petals boat-tailed toward the exits, read closed, moderate. LEX/wing junctions 23-31 px off the at-rest model (slat about 0.3, low-moderate). Flap outboard trailing corners stand aft of the ailerons' trailing edges at the gaps; residuals 2 (right) and 25 (left) px, flaperon about 0.1 with possible roll differential (low). Stabilator tips 12-24 px off (trailing edge up about 0.1, low). STORES: both wingtip launch rails empty (slender red rails with forward fairings, given as pylon); an empty centreline pylon with its rack exposed (5); no wing pylons or fuselage missiles. MARKS: apex = tip of the light radome cap from half-intensity edges (+-2). aoa_* = where each thin vane crosses the forebody outline (right light on the upper outline, left dark on the lower). fin_tip_trailing_* = the corner where each fin's visible outline (its tip edge running forward to where the wing hides it, and its trailing edge running down to the nacelle) turns, intersection of fitted edges (shallow 22-27 deg corners, +-6 along the edges); the fins' leading tips are hidden behind the wings. pod_aft_* = the red lens at the aft end of each fin-tip antenna pod (right a bright red light, left a dark red blob in shade; +-6). splitter_top_right = top of the dark bleed slot ahead of the right splitter plate (noisy, +-5). Wingtip corners (all four: the tip edges show against a thin strip of sky under the empty rails), stabilator tips and flap outboard trailing corners (fold_trailing_*) = intersections of fitted edges; the stabilator trailing tip corners are strongly rounded, so those two are intersections of extended lines (+-10). lex_wing_* ride the LEFs (moving). hook_point = centre of the hook shoe's aft face (+-5). ASIDE: lex_apex_* = where each LEX's edge emerges from the forebody outline (the apexes themselves lie inside the outline; 28-31 px off); inlet_lip_outer_right = top of the right intake's lit C-shaped lip (32 px off, so probably the cowl's edge rather than the lip point). NOT MARKED: inlet corners and the left lip (the lit lip and duct interior cannot be told from the cowl in this noise), splitter_bottom_* and the left splitter, hook_pivot (a round boss at (1235,1511) sits 45 px from where the pivot projects), pitots and nose blade (not resolved against the navy paint), nozzle exits (rims seen from outside, bottom petal not identifiable), fins' leading tips (behind the wings). LEAST SURE: the fin and pod identifications (solo rms 5.9 px over only 8 fixed marks; fin_tip_trailing_left 9.4 px and pod_aft_left 8.5 px pull opposite ways along the fin's trailing edge, confirmed as the visible outline turn and the dark red lens: the lens may sit lower on the pod than the model's aft end), splitter_top_right, all pose angles but gear and hook. SWEEP NOTE: structure is readable through the paint at the planform corners and fins; the busy scheme defeats the intake lips and splitters. Sky pale and cloudless. MERGE (main session, 2026-11-07): set aside by the catalogue's rule for moving marks: wingtip_trailing_left, wingtip_trailing_right, stabilator_tip_leading_left, stabilator_tip_leading_right, stabilator_tip_trailing_left, stabilator_tip_trailing_right, fold_trailing_left, fold_trailing_right, lex_wing_left, lex_wing_right Out of the solve (main session, 2026-11-08): a view from below and ahead, near-orthographic (a field of 1-7 deg), of another operator's jet; with sweep 5's photos in the bundle the gate failed by 2-5 in (the fin tips 2.7 in low, the hook point 5 in, edges to 3 in) where it passed without them, so they stay on file for their marks.

f15265384461.notes: SIDES: belly view (both intake mouths, the stowed hook between the nozzles, the empty centreline pylon) with the nose at photo right. Seen from below with the nose up the page the aircraft's right lies on the photo's left; turned to this heading the aircraft's RIGHT is photo UP and its LEFT photo down. Confirmed by the position lights on the tip-rail fairings: the upper (right) wing's lens is green, the lower (left) wing's red. VIEW: from below and somewhat ahead (solo eye direction about 50 deg below the jet's plane, ahead, slightly right), very long lens: the solo solve is effectively orthographic (f 185k px, eye about 1 km: not meaningful). Near planform: all four wingtip corners, all four stabilator tip corners, both flap/aileron gaps and both LEX/wing junctions are clean silhouette corners; the fins are hidden except the right fin's lower trailing part and both fin-tip pods, which show just outboard of the nacelles beside the wings' trailing edges. Overcast white sky; no vapour. POSE: gear up, hook stowed, canopy closed. Nozzles boat-tailed, read closed (moderate). Each flap's outboard trailing corner stands about 30 px aft of the aileron's trailing edge at the gap and 29-31 px off the at-rest model (flaperon about 0.15, low). LEX/wing junctions 35-39 px off (slat about 0.3, low-moderate). Wingtip corners 24-41 px off the rigid model (bending and aileron). Stabilator tips 19-26 px off (trailing edge up about 0.1, low). STORES: both wingtip launch rails empty (long slender rails with chisel-shaped forward ends, plus the short lens fairings below them), given as pylon; empty centreline pylon with its rack exposed (5); no wing pylons. MARKS: apex = radome tip from half-intensity edges (+-1.5). aoa_* = where each thin vane crosses the forebody outline. pitot_tip_right = forward end of the right pitot tube ahead of its box. blade_nose_bottom_aft and antenna_ventral_tip_aft = the lower-aft ends of the nose and ventral blades, seen as slivers (forward tip corners not separable). lex_apex_right = the sharp tip of the dark right LEX at the forebody outline (9 px: may be where the edge emerges rather than the apex itself, +-3). inlet_corner_* = where each intake's faint lip highlight ridge meets the splitter-side wall (right top confirmed on the pixel ridge, 13 px; left top at the ridge's upper end, low contrast +-5). inlet_lip_outer_* = outboard extreme of each lip's outer contour (+-6 along the rim). splitter_top_right = the pointed upper tip of the right splitter plate's curved leading edge; splitter_bottom_* = the lower ends of the plates' leading edges at the bleed slots' lower ends (+-5). hook_pivot = the fitting at the hook shank's forward end (+-5); hook_point = centre of the shoe's aft face. pod_aft_* = aft extremes of the rounded fin-tip pod ends showing beside the wings' trailing edges (12 px each, opposite ways: the fins' height makes them sensitive to the nearly orthographic camera's tilt; +-5 on the photo). Wingtip corners (tip edges seen against a sliver of sky under the rails), stabilator tips and flap outboard trailing corners = intersections of fitted edges; the stabilator trailing tip corners are strongly rounded, so those two are intersections of extended lines (+-10). lex_wing_* ride the LEFs (moving). ASIDE: lex_apex_left = where the left LEX's edge emerges from the forebody outline (the apex itself is inside the outline; 14 px). NOT MARKED: pitot_tip_left (far side), splitter_top_left (the bleed slot runs on with no visible end of the plate edge), fin tip corners (behind the wings), nozzle exits (rims seen from outside, bottom petal not identifiable). LEAST SURE: the pods, inlet_corner_top_*, all pose angles but gear and hook. MERGE (main session, 2026-11-07): set aside by the catalogue's rule for moving marks: wingtip_trailing_left, wingtip_trailing_right, stabilator_tip_leading_left, stabilator_tip_leading_right, stabilator_tip_trailing_left, stabilator_tip_trailing_right, fold_trailing_left, fold_trailing_right, lex_wing_left, lex_wing_right Out of the solve (main session, 2026-11-08): a view from below and ahead, near-orthographic (a field of 1-7 deg), of another operator's jet; with sweep 5's photos in the bundle the gate failed by 2-5 in (the fin tips 2.7 in low, the hook point 5 in, edges to 3 in) where it passed without them, so they stay on file for their marks.

stores.note: Boxes round the stores a photo may show, for verify/skyline.py: where one lies, no outline is judged, since the model carries no stores and a store's skin passes for sky. Generous envelopes, not geometry: each box is centre and size in inches (station, waterline, buttline) from the station's mount in the points file, buttline taken outboard. Every photo is taken to carry the full load unless its own stores entry says otherwise (null for an empty station): a store left out of the load reads as a false miss, an empty station masked only costs coverage. A photo's entry gives what it shows; a station it hides keeps the default. The kinds' reach is measured on the in-flight photos, cast from their solved cameras onto the store's waterline: the 330-gallon tank runs FS 352-548 on station 7 (mount FS 480.5, dvids7487365), 128 in ahead of its mount to 68 behind; a single missile on an outboard pylon reaches 152 in ahead of its mount (dvids7487365's AGM-88E on station 2) and its axis lies up to 14 in outboard of it; twin AIM-120s on a LAU-115 reach 131 in ahead, 26 in apart across (dvids7487366); the cheek AIM-120 lies about 3 in outboard of and 6 in below its mount (facts.json, station 6); the Litening pod hangs on the centreline at FS 350-445, ahead of station 5's mount, its axis 13 in below it (dvids7487365, dvids9820744, dvids8901347). The ground photos of 164718 (dvids9820748-9820810, one day) carry tanks on the inboard pylons and bare outboard ones: dvids9820799, from ahead and to the right, shows station 2's pylon bare, tanks on 3 and 7 and a dark store on the centreline, station 8 bare and an AIM-9 on 9; dvids9820808's and dvids9820801's tank hangs from the near wing's pylon, station 7 (an earlier reading of dvids9820808 had 7 and 8 bare, which a profile cannot tell from a far-side tank). The in-flight dvids9820744 carries wing tanks and keeps the full load.
